C1.rationale: Level 3: Direct clinical communication with presenting patients, interprofessional liaison with health professionals, and outcome-oriented care delivery.
evidenceLines: Further development of the clinical skills needed to competently examine patients in optometric practice, and recommend appropriate treatment and strategies for patients presenting for primary eye care.
The course aims also to equip students with the skills to incorporate ocular therapeutics into their professional practice and to work in an integrated way with other health professionals.
Evaluate and solve the presenting concerns of each patient and become an outcome-based practitioner

C2.rationale: Level 3: Autonomous diagnostic problem solving and therapeutic management of ocular diseases and complex visual problems under clinical uncertainty.
evidenceLines: The emphasis in this course is the diagnosis and management of visual problems.

Students will develop the ability to competently undertake safe and autonomous therapeutic management of patients, including the ability to design, implement and monitor appropriate management programmes.

C3.rationale: Level 3: Independent critical evaluation of presenting patient symptoms, literature synthesis, and diagnostic outcome assessment.
evidenceLines: Independently conduct optometric examinations, with further exposure to primary care patients to enhance his/her wealth of clinical experience.
Enhance information literacy skills by conducting an analytical literature review.
Evaluate and solve the presenting concerns of each patient and become an outcome-based practitioner

C4.rationale: Level 2: Formulating tailored contact lens management plans, customized spectacle dispensing, and business plans for optometric practice.
evidenceLines: Develop the skill set to construct a business plan to establish or acquire an optometric practice
Prescribe commercially available spectacle frames and lenses to provide the best possible correction for each patient’s refractive requirements
Demonstrate the ability to competently develop an examination plan for a contact lens wearer

C5.rationale: Level 3: Independent scientific research project including hypothesis formulation, experimental design, literature critique, and research execution.
evidenceLines: Undertake independent scientific research and demonstrate understanding of the research process to an area of Vision Science.

This course introduces students to research and the scientific method. The course covers the following: a literature review, critical analysis of the literature, developing a hypothesis, experimental design, ethical considerations, and the research process.

W1.rationale: Level 3: Intensive authentic workplace clinical placements across the UNSW Optometry Clinic, hospital health facilities, and external community practices.
evidenceLines: This program includes placements in Health Facilities in Australia, private practice and the UNSW Optometry Clinic.
You will be required to attend compulsory clinical placements outside the standard teaching period.
You will be required to attend external clinical placements which require additional costs to cover travel and accommodation.

W2.rationale: Level 3: Rigorous clinical governance, statutory background checks, patient safety standards, and ethical scientific practice in eye care.
evidenceLines: This program includes placements in Health Facilities in Australia, private practice and the UNSW Optometry Clinic. In order to attend these placements, students will need to complete a criminal record check.
Understand and apply sound ethical practices during the research process.
Be competent in the prescribing Contact lenses safely and effectively

W3.rationale: Level 3: Mastery of advanced optical instrumentation, ophthalmic diagnostic devices, and ocular therapeutic interventions in patient care.
evidenceLines: Optometry includes the diagnosis and management of ocular disease, the dispensing of spectacles and contact lenses, the management of people with special needs (children, low vision), sports vision and vision in the workplace.
Vision science includes the optics of lenses and instruments, the physiology of the eye, the psychophysics of vision and the neuroscience of the brain.

G1.rationale: Substantial AI exposure in ophthalmic imaging, automated visual field testing, and retinal screening algorithms in primary eye care.
evidenceLines: Vision science includes the optics of lenses and instruments, the physiology of the eye, the psychophysics of vision and the neuroscience of the brain.

G2.rationale: Primary healthcare program combining vision science with physical patient examination, therapeutic interventions, and clinical placements.
evidenceLines: Optometry combines the theoretical discipline of vision science with the clinical art of primary eye care.
This program includes placements in Health Facilities in Australia, private practice and the UNSW Optometry Clinic.
